name: Chengdu Humanoid Robot Innovation Center
name_zh: 成都人形机器人创新中心
summary: Chengdu Humanoid Robot Innovation Center, or CHRIC, is a Chengdu robotics company and research commercialization center. It develops complete humanoid platforms, robot control and decision systems, and sensing technologies. Its own product range includes TangPa, Gongga and Jinbao robots, with applications in public interaction, cultural tourism and embodied intelligence development.
